stockEvidence.semantics: Stock UI prepays diamonds, increments buy_slot_time and capacity, then sends pkgid. No dedicated success RPC is required by this path.

adapter.migration: Missing buy_slot_time becomes 0 on login. Existing capacity and items are preserved.
adapter.validation: Require one stock tier of optimistic expansion and exactly its diamond debit against the saved state.
adapter.commit: Persist debit, count and capacity together; never debit or expand twice.
adapter.failure: Restore saved wallet and package on validation or write failure.
